inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 22nd August, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) issued an alert over the possibility of convective cloud formation accompanied by light to moderate rainfall, which may become heavy at times. The alert is in effect from 13:30 on Saturday until 21:00 the same day. The NCM said the weather conditions are expected to affect some eastern, southern and western areas, extending to parts of the country's interior.

requested_area.areaDesc: Eastern, southern and western areas (demo zone)

fields.description: NCM alert: convective clouds with light to moderate rain, which may become heavy at times, are possible in some eastern, southern and western areas and parts of the interior. In effect Saturday 22 Aug, 13:30 to 21:00.
fields.headline: Rain alert: possible heavy rain at times, Saturday 13:30 to 21:00
fields.instruction: Take care if you are outdoors or driving while it rains. Follow official updates at https://alerts.example.ae.
fields.note_for_reviewer: Urgency is set to Expected and certainty to Possible because NCM described the rain as a possibility. The source also mentions parts of the interior, which may fall outside the operator's target zone. The source gives no timezone, so the 13:30–21:00 window is assumed to be local time.

versions.description: تنبيه من NCM: يُحتمل تشكّل سحب ركامية مصحوبة بأمطار خفيفة إلى متوسطة قد تكون غزيرة أحياناً، على بعض المناطق الشرقية والجنوبية والغربية وأجزاء من المناطق الداخلية. ساري المفعول يوم السبت 22 أغسطس، من 13:30 إلى 21:00.
versions.headline: تنبيه أمطار: احتمال هطول أمطار غزيرة أحياناً، السبت من 13:30 إلى 21:00
versions.instruction: توخَّ الحذر إذا كنت في الخارج أو تقود سيارتك أثناء هطول الأمطار. تابع التحديثات الرسمية على https://alerts.example.ae.
